purpose: Teaching study on original synthetic routing, not natural-language or Jev performance
selection: Highest validation accuracy, then lowest selection NLL, then lower learning rate. Shared selected supervised learning rate across continuation methods in this small teaching study; this does not match Qwen's per-method tuning opportunity.
scope: The validation-reviewed selection pilots preceded this freeze. Main test was not evaluated during those pilots. No early stopping or test-selected training settings. Three observed seeds, no production claims.
